Name: Green and Blue Chickens
Author: TheAiko
Description:
The white and brown chickens become green and blue !

The white chickens become green and the brown chickens become blue,
with Generic Mod Config Menu you can choose wich one you want in your game (default : both).

The name of the chicken at Marnie's stay white and brown chickens as well as the icon.
